title: Inner Monologue: Embodied Reasoning through Planning with Language Models
layout_note: Vertical chat transcript across two columns: the conversation reads top to bottom while arrows hop between the planning column and the feedback column, forming a zig-zag loop; a third column of environment photos stands apart.
grouping: Three columns with bold black headings: 'Robot Planning & Interaction' (a chat transcript), 'Grounded Closed-Loop Feedback' (feedback messages), 'Robot Environments' (three stacked photos (a), (b), (c): a real kitchen with mobile robot, a simulated tabletop with coloured blocks and bowls, a real tabletop). A dashed grey vertical rule separates the first two columns. At the top of the feedback column a small hub diagram places Robot, Scene Descriptor, Success Detector and Human icons in a ring joined by short grey two-way arrows.
shapes_depth: Flat rounded speech bubbles: human turns in grey bubbles beside a black person avatar on the left, robot questions in grey bubbles and robot actions in white bubbles with dashed grey outlines beside a blue-ringed robot icon on the right, each with a small grey speaker name above. Feedback bubbles carry a coloured circular icon (green magnifier for Scene Descriptor, purple bar chart for Success Detector); a scene photo sits under 'I see: coke, water, chocolate bar.'. Light-grey diagonal arrows zig-zag from each action bubble to the feedback that follows and back to the next robot turn.
proposed_highlight: Keywords are coloured inside the text: 'Action:' in orange in every robot action bubble, 'not successful' in red and 'successful' in green in the success-detector replies; actions are told apart from speech by dashed bubble outlines.
lesson: Draw the closed loop as a chat transcript: robot actions in dashed bubbles on one side, perception feedback in solid bubbles with source icons on the other, joined by zig-zag arrows in time order, with outcome words in red and green.
notes: Venue CoRL from Semantic Scholar (title match, venue_source: semantic-scholar); year 2022 = S2 year and arXiv year. layout 'other' = a vertical chat transcript whose turns alternate between two columns, plus a column of environment photos. elements 'other' = speech bubbles.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

taxonomy.task: LLM planning for robot manipulation with closed-loop language feedback

core.what: the closed loop unrolled down the page as a zigzag: grey arrows run right from robot action bubbles in the left chat column to feedback bubbles in the middle column, and back left to the robot's next turn

relations.form: left column 'Robot Planning & Interaction' is a real chat transcript read top to bottom: human turns in grey bubbles with a person avatar, robot actions in dashed bubbles 'Action: "pick up the coke"' with a robot icon

short grey diagonal arrows cross the dashed vertical rule between columns: action -> Scene Descriptor 'I see: coke, water, chocolate bar.' -> robot question; 'pick up the coke' -> Success Detector 'not successful' -> repeated 'pick up the coke' -> 'successful' -> 'bring it to you'
a small hub at the top of the middle column: Robot, Human, Scene Descriptor and Success Detector icons in a ring with grey arrows between them
right column 'Robot Environments': three stacked photos (a) real robot kitchen, (b) simulated tabletop with bowls and blocks, (c) real tabletop with toy food, unconnected to the dialogue

channels.colour: icon outline colour = speaker (blue robot, green Scene Descriptor, purple Success Detector); orange = 'Action:' label; red 'not successful' vs green 'successful' = outcome, so green means both the scene descriptor and success
channels.shape: solid grey bubbles = utterances/feedback, dashed bubbles = robot actions, circular icons = speakers, photos = scenes
channels.line: grey diagonal arrows = messages between planner and feedback sources; a dashed vertical rule separates planning from feedback

quality.strengths: The closed loop is shown with real dialogue rather than boxes, and the zigzag between the two columns makes each feedback round visible as geometry, including the retry after 'not successful'; one real scene photo grounds the scene description.
quality.weaknesses: Green marks both the Scene Descriptor icon and the 'successful' outcome; the right column of environment photos has no link to the dialogue and takes about a sixth of the width; the top hub diagram repeats the speaker icons with arrows that carry no extra information.

insights.structure: Three titled columns: 'Robot Planning & Interaction' (a chat transcript), 'Grounded Closed-Loop Feedback' separated by a dashed vertical rule, and 'Robot Environments' with three stacked photos (a)-(c).
insights.data: Everything is real dialogue: human turns in grey bubbles with a person avatar, robot actions in dashed orange-labelled bubbles 'Action: "pick up the coke"', feedback bubbles from Scene Descriptor and Success Detector icons, plus one real scene photo.
insights.emphasis: Feedback outcomes are coloured red 'not successful' vs green 'successful', and a small hub diagram at the top of the middle column shows robot, human, scene descriptor and success detector exchanging messages.
insights.flow: Top to bottom as a conversation; grey diagonal arrows zigzag between the left action bubbles and the middle feedback bubbles to show the closed loop.
insights.avoid: The right environments column is unrelated to the loop and competes for attention; there is no explicit LLM block, so the planner is implicit.

arrangement.units: vertical columns, one per role (planner dialogue, feedback sources), divided by a dashed rule, plus an unframed photo column
arrangement.inputs_as: a quoted human instruction in a chat bubble with avatar
arrangement.shared: feedback bubbles reply to action bubbles across the dashed rule
